Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Testare și evaluare sisteme IT și Servicii de date pentru sisteme IT
Your new company: 
 Our client is a global leader in financial services technology, operating as a strategic engineering hub that delivers innovative software solutions used across multiple international markets. The teams are focused on building scalable platforms, automating complex business processes, and driving digital transformation through cutting-edge technologies.
 As a Full-stack Developer (Spring Boot & Angular) you will:
Design, develop, and enhance features for modern distributed applications and services.
Produce clean, maintainable, and high-quality code following established engineering best practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Contribute to architectural discussions by evaluating emerging technologies, frameworks, and development approaches.
Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and ongoing enhancements.
Build solutions capable of supporting high-performance, scalable, and business-critical environments.
Promote agile ways of working and contribute to continuous improvements in development processes.
Partner closely with software engineers, data specialists, product stakeholders, and business teams to deliver impactful solutions.
 What you need to succeed: 
Tech-stack: Java 17+, Spring Boot 3.x, Angular 17+
Proven experience in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise-grade software solutions.
Solid experience with modern Java development frameworks and backend application design.
Experience building responsive and user-friendly web applications using contemporary frontend technologies.
Familiarity with message-driven architectures and asynchronous communication patterns.
Knowledge of containerization technologies and cloud-based environments is considered an advantage.
Understanding of distributed systems, service-oriented architectures, and API design principles.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.
